ex.s: In 1863 the first underground passenger railway in the world opened in London.
ex.t: 1863年，世界上第一条地下客运铁路在伦敦开通。

ex.s: All this time, the song “Sky Railway” has been playing inside my head.
ex.t: 这一路上，歌曲《天路》一直在我脑海中回响。

ex.s: The words “railways like massive dragons are winding among the mountains” seem particularly vivid as I travel across the “roof of the world”.
ex.t: 当我穿越“世界屋脊”时， “铁路像巨龙一样在山间蜿蜒”这句话似乎特别生动。

ex.s: Taking years to complete, the Qinghai-Tibet Railway is a record of all of our efforts to overcome the most difficult engineering challenges.
ex.t: 耗时多年才完成的青藏铁路，是我们克服最艰巨工程挑战的所有努力的记录。

ex.s: Thirty-three passages have been built under the railway to allow the animals to move safely and freely in their natural habitat.
ex.t: 铁路下面已经修建了33条通道，让动物们能够在自然栖息地中安全自由地移动。

ex.s: The more regularly they can be inspected, the more railway safety, reliability and on-time performance will be improved.
ex.t: 这包括节省大量的维护成本和更好地保护铁路人员的安全。

ex.s: By using the latest technologies, drones could also start providing higher-value services for railways, detecting faults in the rail or switches, before they can cause any safety problems.
ex.t: 通过使用最新技术，无人机还可以开始为铁路提供更高价值的服务，在铁轨或道岔的故障引发安全问题之前就检测出来。

ex.s: D How Drones Will Change the Future of Railways
ex.t: D 无人机将如何改变铁路的未来

ex.s: They could do precisely the same thing to inspect railway lines and other vital aspects of rail infrastructure such as the correct position of railway tracks and switching points.
ex.t: 检查越频繁，铁路的安全性、可靠性和准点率就会越高。

ex.s: That includes huge savings in maintenance costs and better protection of railway personnel safety.
ex.t: 这包括维护成本的大幅节省和对铁路人员安全的更好保护。

defs.def: a system of tracks, together with the trains that run on them, and the organization and people needed to operate them 铁路公司；铁道部门；铁路系统

ex.s: It is calculated that European railways alone spend approximately 20 billion euros a year on maintenance, including sending maintenance staff, often at night, to inspect and repair the rail infrastructure.
ex.t: 这可能是危险的工作，如果有无人机协助工作人员就可以避免这种危险。

ex.s: Located at over 5,000 meters above sea level, this is the highest railway station in the world.
ex.t: 位于海拔五千多米处，这是世界上最高的火车站。
